Note that this method is not enforced on all affected bean definitions
but rather taken as an optional callback, to be invoked if actually present.

items.source:
Set the autowire mode. This determines whether any automagical detection
and setting of bean references will happen. Default is AUTOWIRE_NO
which means there won't be convention-based autowiring by name or type
(however, there may still be explicit annotation-driven autowiring).
items.translation: 设置自动线束模式。此选项决定是否会进行任何神奇的 Bean 引用检测和设置。默认值为 AUTOWIRE_NO，这意味着不会通过名称或类型进行基于约定的自动线束（然而，仍可能存在显式的注解驱动的自动线束）。

items.source: autowireMode - the autowire mode to set. Must be one of the constants defined in AbstractBeanDefinition.
items.translation: autowireMode - 要设置的自动装配模式。必须是 AbstractBeanDefinition 中定义的常量之一。

items.source: dependencyCheck - the code to set. Must be one of the constants defined in AbstractBeanDefinition.
items.translation: `dependencyCheck` - 要设置的代码。必须是 AbstractBeanDefinition 中定义的常量之一。

items.source: whether to apply lazy-init semantics (false by default)
items.translation: 是否应用懒加载语义（默认为false）

items.source: If false, the bean will get instantiated on startup by bean factories that perform eager initialization of singletons.
items.translation: 如果为false，则单例的 Bean 工厂将在启动时执行单例的急切初始化。
